ValidationRule.description: To Prevent Account Managers from creating FPD Quotes when FPD Toggle Switch is OFF
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRBypassToggle__c )), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', $CustomMetadata.PMC_CPQ_FPDToggleSwitch__mdt.PMC_CPQ_FPDQuoting.PMC_CPQ_Switch__c =False, OR( ISPICKVAL(PMC_CPQ_QuoteRecordType__c,'Domestic NA'),ISPICKVAL(PMC_CPQ_QuoteRecordType__c,'International')), OR(ISPICKVAL(PMC_CPQ_ContractType__c,'FPD'),ISPICKVAL(PMC_CPQ_ContractType__c,'FPD Ex-Space')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The ability to Quote FPDs is currently on hold. For more information, please reach out to a Product Manager
